SHORT ANSWERAsk questions that show you've already started solving their problems, not just learning about the company. Focus on how your unique skills will contribute to their specific goals, using details from the job posting and your resume to frame your inquiries. Your questions should reveal your strategic value, not just your curiosity.

That moment at the end of an interview, when they turn the tables and ask, "Do you have any questions for us?" can feel like a pop quiz. Most anxious job seekers just want to get through it, but this is actually your final, best chance to show them you're the solution to their problems. I promise, you can turn this moment into a powerful demonstration of your value.

ONE LINE EACH Who I am The proof What I want next say it in one breath

FIG. 02I used to ramble when someone asked what I did. Now I keep three lines ready: who I am, the proof, and what I want next. When all three stack into one breath, people remember you.

  • 01 How do I show I've already started thinking about their problems?

Frame your questions around specific challenges or goals mentioned in the job posting or throughout the interview, demonstrating youâre already in problem-solving mode for them. This shifts you from interviewee to potential partner, showing youâre not just looking for a job, but for impact. Youâre not asking what they do; youâre asking how you can help them do it better.

For example, if the posting mentions expanding into a new market, you might ask, "I noticed the posting highlighted a push into the APAC region. What specific metrics are you tracking for success in that expansion over the next 12 months, and how do you see this role directly contributing to those early wins?" This tells them you read the posting, you understand their strategic direction, and you're already thinking about measurable outcomes. It's a much stronger signal than, "What's the team culture like?" I want you to make every question a mini pitch for your specific skills.

  • 02

Should I ask about the 30/60/90 day plan?

Asking about the 30/60/90 day plan is a smart move, but only if you frame it to show how you'd execute your own plan, not just hear theirs. This question can reveal critical expectations and allow you to align your prepared 30/60/90 day plan from your Baldwin Blueprint with their vision. It's about demonstrating initiative and foresight.

Instead of "What would my 30/60/90 day plan look like?" try, "Based on our conversation about [specific challenge or project], what would be the top one or two priorities you'd want someone in this role to tackle and deliver measurable results on within their first 90 days?" This invites them to share their critical needs, and you can then connect those needs to your own Experience Accelerator and 30/60/90 day plan, which your Blueprint helps you build from the actual job posting. It shows you're not just waiting for instructions; you're ready to hit the ground running with concrete contributions.

Four rooms, four scorecards Manager Peer Partner Skip level JUDGMENT CRAFT TEAMWORK GROWTH answer the real scorer

FIG. 03An interview loop is not one test, it is four. Each person in the room is measuring a different thing: the hiring manager scores judgment, the peer scores craft, the cross functional partner scores collaboration, and the skip level scores trajectory. Speak to what each one is actually grading. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What's a question that shows I'm thinking long-term?

A question that shows you're thinking long-term connects your potential contributions to the company's broader strategic goals, positioning you as an investment, not just a hire. This demonstrates ambition and a desire to grow with the company, making your candidacy more compelling. Itâs about signaling that you see a future with them.

Consider asking, "Beyond the immediate responsibilities, what are the biggest strategic shifts or initiatives this team expects to navigate in the next 18 to 24 months, and how does this role evolve to support those changes?" This shows you're looking beyond the immediate tasks and are interested in the trajectory of the company and your potential role within it. It's a question that conveys seriousness about your career and their future, which hiring managers appreciate. It pushes past the tactical and into the strategic, which is where true impact lies.

THEY ASK Any questions for us? YOU ASK Where do projects stall before they ship? this is the interview too

FIG. 04The questions you ask are part of the interview, not a polite afterthought. When they ask if you have questions, skip the perks and ask about the real work: what success looks like in 90 days, where projects stall, who owns the roadmap. The questions you ask reveal how you think, so make them sharp.

  • 04 Is there anything I should absolutely NOT ask?

Avoid asking questions that are easily answered by a quick search of the company website or questions solely focused on benefits, salary, or vacation time at this stage. These types of questions signal a lack of preparation or a self-serving focus, detracting from your professional image. Your final questions should reinforce your value, not raise doubts.

I also tell people to avoid asking questions that are overly generic or could apply to any company, like "What do you like most about working here?" While it's okay to build rapport, your final questions are for demonstrating strategic fit. Save the generic questions for networking calls, not the interview's closing act. Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to ask what you want to know, not what *they* need to hear. Your Baldwin Blueprint helps you identify their core needs directly from the job posting, so your questions can be laser focused on those.

  • 05

How do I ask a question that makes me stand out?

Ask a question that directly references a detail from your resume or the job posting, then connect it to a strategic signal or an Account Map insight from your Baldwin Blueprint. This type of question makes you memorable because it's specific, personalized, and demonstrates deep preparation. It shows you've done your homework and understand their world.

For example, if your resume highlights a specific project management success, and the job posting emphasizes improving project timelines, you could ask: "Given my experience leading the [Project Name] initiative, where we reduced delivery times by 15%, what are the current bottlenecks in your project pipeline that you envision this role specifically addressing?" This isn't just a question; it's a subtle reminder of your relevant achievements and a direct offer to solve their problems. Itâs about making a direct link between your past success and their future needs. This is the difference between a good candidate and the one they can't stop thinking about.

Worked example

  • 30/60/90 line

Before

What are the biggest challenges this role will face?

After

Based on my research into your Q3 earnings call, where you discussed streamlining supply chain logistics, what specific data sources or key stakeholders would be critical for me to engage with in my first 30 days to begin mapping out an optimization strategy for that area?

Interview Questions: Impact vs. Inquiry What most people do What actually works Ask about team culture or company benefits. Ask how your specific skills solve their problems. Ask for a job description summary. Refer to a specific point from the job posting or their website. Ask generic questions from a list. Craft questions that lead to an offer, not just information. Ask questions that show you're curious. Ask questions that show you're already contributing. Wait to be told what to do. Propose how you'll make an immediate impact.

The takeaways

  • 01Ask questions that solve problems, not just gather info.
  • 02Reference the job posting and your resume directly.
  • 03Frame questions to reveal your strategic value.
  • 04Use your 30/60/90 plan to guide your questions.

Questions people ask

What if I don't have any questions left after our conversation?

It's rare that you won't have any questions if you're truly engaged, but if it happens, you can say, "You've been incredibly thorough, and I feel I have a strong understanding of the role and team. I'm confident I can contribute significantly." Then, pivot to reiterating your interest and fit. You can also offer to follow up if new questions arise.

Is this just a fancy cover letter? What does Baldwin Blueprint actually do?

No, it's much more. A cover letter is static. Baldwin Blueprint turns the actual job posting and your resume into a living 12 page strategic Blueprint you walk in with. It includes an Impact Memo, an Account Map, Strategic Signals, an Experience Accelerator, and a 30/60/90 day plan tailored specifically to that role. It's built from the actual posting, and the first draft is free, no card required. It gives you concrete, specific content for every stage of the interview, including the questions you ask.

How many questions should I ask?

Aim for 2 to 3 strong, impactful questions. Quality over quantity. You want to leave them thinking about your insights, not just how many questions you had. If your questions are strategic and well-researched, you won't need many to make a lasting impression. Focus on the ones that highlight your unique value and understanding of the role.

What if the interviewer seems rushed?

If they seem rushed, acknowledge it respectfully. "I know we're short on time, so I'll just ask one key question: based on our conversation, what's the single most critical challenge this role needs to solve in the first 6 months?" This shows you're observant and considerate, while still landing a powerful, focused question. It's about adapting to the situation while still making your point.

By Chris Baldwin

SHORT ANSWERTranslate 'fast-paced environment' as a warning that the company lacks clear processes, has shifting priorities, and expects you to manage your own chaos. It means you must make decisions with incomplete data and execute tasks quickly without waiting for permission or perfect instructions.

Seeing 'fast-paced environment' in a job posting usually makes your stomach drop because it sounds like a recipe for instant burnout. I will show you how to decode this phrase so you can spot the warning signs and prove you can handle the actual work. You will walk away with a concrete strategy to turn this vague requirement into your biggest unfair advantage.

They need I can prove Scale a team Cut churn Ship fast Hired 9 Cut it 22% Weekly ships line them up first

FIG. 02Before I write a single line, I draw two columns: what they need on the left, what I can prove on the right. Then I draw lines connecting them. The gaps that have no line tell me exactly what to address in the cover note.

  • 01 Is 'fast-paced' just code for understaffed and chaotic?

A fast-paced environment means the company has more work than people and lacks the structured systems to manage the daily overflow. It is often a direct signal that priorities change weekly, resources are scarce, and you will be expected to self-manage through constant operational friction.

I see this constantly. Startups use this phrase because they are building the plane while flying it, while larger companies use it to excuse their broken internal processes. It is a structural reality.

You need to ask the hiring manager how they prioritize projects when everything is labeled urgent. Ask them to describe a week when a major goal shifted mid-flight.

  • 02

How do I prove I can thrive in this kind of chaos?

Prove your capability by sharing specific examples of times you managed competing deadlines, made decisions with limited data, and built your own templates to survive. You must demonstrate that you do not need a perfect manual to execute your daily tasks and deliver real results.

Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to say you love speed. Do not do that. Instead, give them a concrete example, like how you managed a sudden product launch delay by shifting your team's focus to customer documentation.

For example, a customer support lead could explain how they handled a forty percent spike in tickets without extra budget by building a temporary automated triage system.

fifty generic five sharp ones weight wins, not stack height

FIG. 03I weighed fifty generic applications against five sharp ones, and the five tailored to the role still tipped the scale. Fit carries more than sheer count. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What are the red flags to watch out for in the interview?

Red flags appear when interviewers cannot define what success looks like in the first ninety days or when they brag about working late nights. If they describe the culture as a family that works hard and plays hard, expect uncompensated overtime and poor boundaries.

I want you to listen to their vocabulary. If they use words like firefighting or wearing many hats too often, run.

Here is your honest caveat. A strategic blueprint can prepare you for the interview, but it cannot fix a toxic boss once you take the job. You must use the interview to screen them just as much as they screen you.

  • 04

How does a 30/60/90 day plan help me address this?

A structured plan addresses this by showing the hiring manager you know how to onboard yourself without draining their limited time or resources. It proves you can identify quick wins, map out key stakeholders, and establish your own workflow within your first month on the job.

This is where the Baldwin Blueprint comes in. When you walk in with a 30/60/90 day plan built from their actual job posting, you show them you do not need hand-holding.

You are telling them, I see the chaos, and here is exactly how I plan to organize my first ninety days to relieve your pressure.

Worked example

  • STAR answer

Before

I work really well under pressure and I am used to fast-paced environments where things change quickly.

After

When our main supplier shut down with zero notice, I did not wait for leadership to act. I built a temporary tracking sheet, sourced three local backup vendors within forty-eight hours, and kept our production line running without a single hour of downtime.

How to handle 'fast-paced' in your application What most people do What actually works Write generic resume bullets about multitasking Quantify how you managed shifting priorities and tight deadlines Nod and say you love a challenge during the interview Ask how the team handles resource constraints and shifting goals Wait for the company to train you on their systems Present a 30/60/90 day plan showing how you will onboard yourself

The takeaways

  • 01Fast-paced usually means shifting priorities and limited resources.
  • 02Prove you can self-manage with concrete, quantified examples.
  • 03Use the interview to screen for toxic, disorganized environments.
  • 04A 30/60/90 day plan shows you do not need hand-holding.

Questions people ask

Does fast-paced always mean I will have to work overtime?

Not always, but it usually means your working hours will be intense and highly focused. It often points to poor project management, which can bleed into your personal time if you do not set firm boundaries early in your tenure.

Is Baldwin Blueprint just a fancy cover letter generator?

No, it is a comprehensive twelve page strategic document that includes an Impact Memo, Account Map, and 30/60/90 day plan. It does not write generic cover letters. It analyzes the actual job posting to build a concrete execution plan you can use in your interview.

How do I ask about work-life balance without sounding lazy?

Ask how the team prioritizes work when everything is urgent. A good manager will explain their triage process, while a bad one will tell you that everything simply has to get done, which is your cue to walk away.

title: Influencer Marketing Lead
description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

description:
About us

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

  • Deliver Customer Success handovers that consistently meet or exceed acceptance criteria, maintaining high CSAT across your portfolio.
  • Use insights from account work to identify patterns and inform program improvement.
Program Management
  • Design the playbooks and SOPs for Scale-touch and High-touch onboarding, maintaining accuracy and ensuring they reflect current best practice.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives: identifying inefficiencies, designing solutions, and driving rollout across the team.
  • Coordinate with Scaled and Digital Onboarding Managers to ensure program consistency across all onboarding formats.
  • Manage content accuracy as a program responsibility, working with Product to keep onboarding resources current after releases.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Build credibility with stakeholders through consistent delivery and clear communication.
  • Represent the program perspective in cross-functional meetings, contributing structured analysis and concrete recommendations.

  • Facilitate complex discovery conversations that surface strategic use cases and inform onboarding design.

Feedback, Reporting & Process Improvement

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.
  • Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations.
  • Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections.
  • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.


Salary information

Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.

Gute Kommunikation braucht nicht nur die richtigen Worte. Sie braucht eine visuelle Idee, die komplexe Inhalte verständlich macht, Marken wiedererkennbar werden lässt und über unterschiedliche Formate hinweg funktioniert.
Genau dabei unterstützt du unser Team. Du gestaltest Inhalte für PIABO und unsere Kund:innen aus der Digitalwirtschaft, von Informationsgrafiken und Whitepapern bis zu Social Media Content, Präsentationen und Markenauftritten. Wir suchen keine Person, die Gestaltung nur sauber ausführt. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, visuelle Zusammenhänge erkennt und Lust hat, aus einem Briefing eine überzeugende Lösung mitzuentwickeln.


Was du bei uns tust und wie

Das liegt in deiner Verantwortung:

  • Du konzipierst und gestaltest Informationsgrafiken und Illustrationen, die auch komplexe Inhalte klar und verständlich vermitteln.
  • Du erstellst Layouts für Whitepaper, Broschüren und weitere Publikationen und bereitest die zugehörigen Druckdaten zuverlässig auf.
  • Du übernimmst Bildbearbeitung und Retusche und sorgst dafür, dass Bildwelten konsistent und hochwertig umgesetzt werden.
  • Du organisierst deine Aufgaben strukturiert und behältst Qualitätsanforderungen, Formate und Timings im Blick.

Das machst du gemeinsam mit dem Team:
  • Du entwickelst Social Media Content wie Grafiken, Posts und kurze Videos für interne und externe Kommunikationskanäle.
  • Du gestaltest Geschäftsausstattung, zum Beispiel Messestände, Roll ups und Visitenkarten.
  • Du bereitest Präsentationen visuell auf und entwickelst Mastertemplates, mit denen Teams konsistent weiterarbeiten können.
  • Du wirkst an Corporate Designs und Markenauftritten für unsere Kund:innen mit und übersetzt strategische Ideen in konkrete Gestaltung.
  • Gelegentlich konzipierst und gestaltest du Webdesigns und Prototypen mit Wix, WordPress oder Figma.

Hier bekommst du gezieltes Onboarding von uns:
  • AI und Bildgenerierung: Du lernst, wie wir Prompts entwickeln, visuelle Ergebnisse bewerten und KI sinnvoll in kreative Prozesse integrieren.
  • Designprozesse bei PIABO: Wir zeigen dir, wie Briefings, Feedbackschleifen, Kund:innenanforderungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit PR, Content, Social Media und Brand Strategy bei uns funktionieren.
  • Tools und Workflows: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einführung in unsere Arbeitsweise mit der Adobe Creative Cloud und der Google Suite sowie in relevante Vorlagen und Ablagestrukturen.
  • Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung über die PIABO Academies.


Drei Must-haves für die Stelle

  • Du studierst Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, Mediendesign oder ein vergleichbares Fach und kannst uns anhand eines Portfolios zeigen, wie du an Gestaltung herangehst.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Adobe InDesign, , Premiere Pro, After Effects und Photoshop. Unsere Projekte reichen von druckfertigen Broschüren bis zu digitalen Assets. Deshalb solltest du Ideen nicht nur entwickeln, sondern technisch sauber und zuverlässig umsetzen können.
  • Du bist neugierig auf neue Formen visueller Arbeit. AI Prompting und KI gestützte Bildgenerierung gehören für uns zum modernen Designprozess. Du musst noch kein AI Profi sein, solltest aber ausprobieren wollen, wie Technologie deine Arbeit besser und nicht beliebiger macht.

Die Stelle umfasst 20 Stunden pro Woche, ist befristet und hybrid in Berlin oder München angelegt.


What’s in it for you?

  • Abwechslungsreiche Designprojekte für innovative Unternehmen aus der Tech und Digitalwirtschaft.
  • Echte Einblicke in Agenturarbeit und die Möglichkeit, deine Entwürfe in unterschiedlichen Formaten und Kanälen zum Einsatz zu bringen.
  • AI Upskilling als Teil deiner Arbeit mit konkreten Anwendungsfällen in Design und Bildgenerierung.
  • Mac Ausstattung und die Tools, die du für professionelle Gestaltung brauchst.
  • Urban Sports Club sowie fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung über die PIABO Academies.
  • Ein Team, das dir Feedback gibt, dir Verantwortung zutraut und deine gestalterische Perspektive ernst nimmt.
  • Und ein paar gute Gründe mehr, die erzählen wir dir gern persönlich.


Kontakt

Klingt spannend? Dann bewirb dich gerne bei Nele aus dem PIABO People Team.

title: Senior Manager New Business &  Strategic Growth (w/m/x)
description:
Warum gibt es diese Stelle?

PIABO wächst dann nachhaltig, wenn wir zur richtigen Zeit mit den richtigen Menschen im Gespräch sind. Dafür reicht es nicht, auf Pitch-Anfragen zu warten. 
Wir wollen relevante Märkte früh verstehen, Beziehungen langfristig aufbauen und aus guten Kontakten passende Mandate entwickeln.
Was wir dafür brauchen: eine Person, die New Business als strategisches Handwerk versteht. Die den Markt liest, Chancen einordnet und verbindlich nachfasst. Und die mit Entscheider:innen aus Technologie, Venture Capital, Innovation und Unternehmenskommunikation auf Augenhöhe spricht.


Was du bei uns tust und wie

Das liegt in deiner Verantwortung:

  • Pipeline und Markt: Du baust eine belastbare New-Business-Pipeline auf, identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen und erkennst früh, wann sich durch Finanzierungsrunden, neue Führungsrollen, Markteintritte oder andere Veränderungen eine Chance für PIABO öffnet.
  • Kontakte und Beziehungen: Du entwickelst passende Gesprächsanlässe, baust Beziehungen zu potenziellen Kund:innen, Investor:innen, Partner:innen und Multiplikator:innen auf und vertrittst PIABO in relevanten Netzwerken und auf Events.
  • Qualifizierung: Du prüfst Chancen früh und sorgfältig. Budget, Timing, Umfang, Entscheidungsprozess, kulturelle Passung und strategisches Potenzial sind geklärt, bevor wir größere Ressourcen einsetzen.
  • Pitch-Prozesse: Du steuerst Pitches gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und unseren Beratungsteams. Du sorgst dafür, dass Briefing, Team, Rollen, Zeitplan, Vorbereitung und Nachbereitung stimmen.
  • Wachstumssystem: Du verbindest New Business mit PR, Thought Leadership, Events, LinkedIn, Partnerschaften und öffentlichen Ausschreibungen.
  • Struktur und Auswertung: Du entwickelst CRM, Target Lists und Follow-ups weiter und wertest aus, welche Kontakte, Leads und Pitches zu passenden Mandaten führen.

Hier bekommst du gezieltes Onboarding von uns:
  • PIABO, unsere Leistungen und unser Markt: Du lernst unsere Beratungsteams, Kund:innen, Branchen und Wachstumsfelder im Detail kennen.
  • AI und Weiterentwicklung: Du nimmst an unserem AI Bootcamp teil und entwickelst dich fachlich und persönlich über die PIABO Academies weiter.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast relevante Erfahrung in New Business, Business Development, Growth, B2B-Sales und -Vertrieb, Client Development oder Beratung. Du kennst das Agenturgeschäft, eine Kommunikationsberatung, Strategieberatung, Kreativagentur, Tech-Agentur oder ein vergleichbares B2B-Umfeld. Du weißt, wie Agenturen wachsen und wie man Chancen bewertet, bevor sie Zeit und Ressourcen binden.
  • Du kannst mit CEOs, CMOs, Founder Teams und Investor:innen auf Augenhöhe sprechen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen, Timing und Relevanz, schreibst klar und fasst verbindlich nach. Akquise gibt dir Energie, ohne dass du platt vertrieblich auftrittst.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und konsequent. CRM, Target Lists, Kontaktpunkte, Follow-ups und klare Routinen sind für dich die Grundlage guter Arbeit. Pitches, RFIs, RFPs, Chemistry Meetings, Engagement Workshops und öffentliche Ausschreibungen kennst du aus der Praxis.


What’s in it for you?

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Die Chance, ein New-Business-System aufzubauen, das zur nächsten Wachstumsphase von PIABO passt.
  • Eine Rolle mit Sichtbarkeit in relevanten Märkten, Netzwerken und Technologie-Ökosystemen.
  • AI Upskilling als Standard: AI Bootcamp, Tools Stack und der Freiraum, deinen Arbeitsbereich mit AI wirklich besser zu machen.
  • Apple Ausstattung, Urban Sports Club, Jobrad und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Und ein paar gute Gründe mehr, die erzählen wir dir gern persönlich.

title: Senior AI Strategist (m/f/x) – European AI Readiness Observatory
description:
About us

Das appliedAI Institute for Europe hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, das europäische KI-Ökosystem zu stärken, Forschung im Bereich KI voranzutreiben, Wissen rund um KI zu entwickeln, vertrauenswürdige KI-Tools bereitzustellen und Bildungs- sowie Interaktionsformate rund um hochwertige KI-Inhalte zu schaffen.
Wir stellen die Menschen in Europa in den Mittelpunkt und verfolgen die Vision, eine gemeinsame KI-Community zu formen und hochwertige Inhalte im Zeitalter der KI für die gesamte Gesellschaft bereitzustellen. Durch die Förderung von vertrauenswürdiger KI beschleunigen wir die Anwendung dieser Technologie und stärken das Vertrauen in KI-Lösungen.


Your mission

Als Senior AI Strategist im AI Public Interest & Policy Team des appliedAI Institute for Europe übersetzt du technologische KI-Entwicklungen in Orientierungswissen für Entscheidungsträger:innen in Wirtschaft, Politik und Verwaltung. Du übernimmst Produktverantwortung für das European AI Readiness Observatory Programm (Arbeitstitel), das politisch-strategische Flaggschiffprodukt des Instituts*, und gestaltest dessen inhaltliche und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung aktiv mit. Als Teil eines kleinen, wachsenden Teams arbeitest du eng mit der Head of AI Public Interest & Policy zusammen und bringst eigene Netzwerke, Perspektiven und unternehmerisches Urteilsvermögen für die Arbeit in einer gemeinnützigen Organisation ein.

Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Du verantwortest die inhaltliche produktbezogene Weiterentwicklung des European AI Readiness Observatory und hältst es gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Expert:innen aktuell
  • Die quartalsweisen Entscheider:innen-Briefings sowie der jährliche AI Readiness Outlook entstehen unter deiner Federführung, von der Recherche bis zur zielgruppengerechten Aufbereitung für Wirtschaft, Politik und Verwaltung
  • Du konzipierst und koordinierst Roundtables und baust dabei ein tragfähiges Netzwerk zu Forschung, Think Tanks, Medien sowie politischen Akteur:innen auf nationaler und europäischer Ebene auf
  • In Studien- und Beratungsmandaten des Teams übernimmst du eigenständige Arbeitspakete, von digitaler Souveränität bis zu Fragen der Arbeitsmarkttransformation 
  • Ergänzend erarbeitest du Policy Briefs und Stellungnahmen zu aktuellen politischen Entwicklungen
  • Für neue Projekte entwickelst du Drittmittelanträge und Projektskizzen


Your profile

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Zukunftsforschung, Politikwissenschaft, (Sozio-)Informatik, Wirtschaft, Sozialwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Feld sowie fundiertes Verständnis aktueller KI-Entwicklungen wie Capability-Benchmarks, Frontier-Modelle und agentische KI
  • Mindestens 5–7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Think Tanks, Beratung, Stiftungswesen, Policy-Arbeit oder Verwaltung, idealerweise mit einem ausgeprägten Netzwerk in deutschen oder europäischen gesellschaftspolitischen Kreisen
  • Nachweisliche Stärke darin, technische KI-Entwicklungen für nicht-technische Entscheidungsträger:innen zu übersetzen und in klare Handlungsorientierung zu überführen
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Steuerung von Publikationsformaten und -produkten – von Policy Briefs über Studien bis zu Dashboards - mit Gespür für Produktverantwortung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung
  • Erfahrung mit Community-Management, der Koordination von Expert:innennetzwerken sowie der Konzeption und Durchführung politischer Veranstaltungsformate
  • Erfahrung mit Drittmittelakquise und Projektentwicklung sowie eine eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise in kleinen Teams
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
*Das European AI Readiness Observatory* ist ein neues Flagship-Programm des appliedAI Institute for Europe. Es stärkt die Handlungsfähigkeit von Wirtschaft, Politik und Verwaltung in der KI-Transformation – mit Orientierungswissen, das unabhängig entsteht, laufend aktualisiert wird und in konkretes Handeln übersetzt ist. Kern ist ein KI-Lagebild der Frontier-Entwicklung, das mögliche Entwicklungspfade über 36 Monate und in einem teilautomatisierten, von Expert:innen validierten Verfahren aktualisiert wird. Der Impact Explorer überträgt die Befunde auf zehn gesellschaftliche Wirkungsfelder; drei Readiness Layer machen daraus Handlungsoptionen für die Zielgruppen – von Policy Briefs bis zu Leadership Frameworks. Der Prototyp „Preparing for the Age of AI" läuft seit April 2026 im öffentlichen Betrieb.


What we offer

  • Ein hochqualifiziertes und motiviertes Team von ca. 35 Personen, das die sich schnell entwickelnde europäische KI-Landschaft aktiv mitgestaltet
  • Das Beste aus beiden Welten mit unserem hybriden Arbeitsmodell: Arbeite aus unseren lebendigen Büros - entweder im IPAI in Heilbronn oder im House of Communication in München - und genieße gleichzeitig die Flexibilität, einige Tage pro Woche remote zu arbeiten
  • Die Möglichkeit, vielfältige Projekte mitzugestalten und neue, originelle Inhalte auf Basis der neuesten KI-Entwicklungen und deren Anwendung in der Gesellschaft zu entwickeln
  • Eine Atmosphäre, die dazu ermutigt, mit Software, Hardware und Prozessen zu denken und zu experimentieren
  • Ein sehr sichtbares Ökosystem, das dir hilft, ein großes und hochkarätiges Netzwerk aus Start-ups, Partnern und Tech-Unternehmen aufzubauen
  • Ein flexibles Weiterbildungsbudget, das du frei gestalten kannst - investiere es in Trainings, Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen oder neue Herausforderungen, ganz wie du wachsen möchtest

title: Senior AI Consultant / Project Lead (m/f/x)
description:
About us

The appliedAI Initiative elevates Europe’s industry to become shapers in the age of AI, creating a future that we desire to live in. Through our ecosystem of strong partners, comprehensive programs, services and solutions we advance companies holistically on their AI journey. With our uniquely diverse, interdisciplinary, and driven team, we build on deep technical expertise while specializing on applicability of the solutions. We share a mindset of collaboration and openness with our ecosystem of leading companies and tech players. Our common goal is to strengthen the European landscape, jointly creating unique knowledge for applying trustworthy AI. We believe that AI Agents will be the dominant topic for AI in the near future and that appliedAI with its partner ecosystem will impact how this technology is being used in industry and beyond in Europe.


Your mission

We're looking for a Senior AI Consultant ready to take ownership of strategic AI engagements with our partner companies - from DAX corporations to leading “Mittelstand” businesses. You'll become the day-to-day face of delivery for your clients and the go-to owner for a focus topic internally, designing solutions for novel and ambiguous problems while coaching the people around you. You'll work closely with our (Technical) AI Consultants, AI Engineers, and adjacent teams such as Enablement & Change and Trustworthy AI.

Your tasks will include:

  • Own delivery end-to-end across scoping, planning, staffing, execution, and risk - orchestrating multi-workstream engagements and creating clarity for the team in ambiguous situations
  • Drive the development and implementation of AI strategies, effective operating models, and high-value (agentic) AI use case portfolios for DAX and “Mittelstand” clients
  • Navigate and align the full stakeholder landscape, facilitating resolution of conflicting agendas and delivering difficult messages diplomatically - building relationships where you're seen as a partner, not a vendor
  • Lead cross-functional project teams, assign responsibilities, coach team members, and create teachable moments
  • Identify expansion opportunities during delivery, contribute to proposals with meaningful ownership, and supply credible sizing, staffing, and timeline options while protecting margin
  • Build a recognized specialization in a topic or industry, design custom approaches for novel client situations, and stay at the frontier of state-of-the-art AI research and emerging capabilities
  • Co-own topics within the Strategy & Transformation team, develop assets that scale our offering, and share patterns and lessons learned through case shares


Your profile

  • An outstanding academic record in a business- or tech-related subject
  • Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting and/or Management Consulting, with a track record of owning complex projects end-to-end
  • Hands-on experience applying AI within companies, combining strategic project management with strong technical expertise
  • Resilience in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, with the judgement and composure to keep a team focused through rapid iteration
  • A business development mindset and strong awareness of stakeholder dynamics - able to navigate and align conflicting interests among senior stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills - translate complex AI topics into business impact for any audience, from C-Level to operational teams
  • Fluent in English and German, communicating confidently with both customers and colleagues in either language


What we offer

  • A highly qualified and motivated team of ~90 people is on a journey to change the rapidly evolving European AI Landscape
  • Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model: You can choose to work from our vibrant offices - either at the IPAI in Heilbronn or the House of Communication in Munich - while also enjoying the flexibility to work remotely a few days each week
  • Opportunity to shape a variety of projects and the development of new, original content based on the latest developments in AI and its adoption in businesses
  • An atmosphere that encourages to think and experiment in new ways with software, hardware, and processes
  • A highly visible initiative that helps you build a large and high-level network of start-ups, partners, and tech companies
  • No fixed budget for growth – you decide how you want to develop, whether through training, certifications, conferences, or new challenges
  • Sports membership with Wellpass to access thousands of sports facilities all over Germany (and beyond), as well as online courses
  • JobRad: Lease a bike for a cheaper rate via JobRad and we cover the bike insurance on top 
  • Sabbatical option: You can take a sabbatical of up to 3 months after min. 3 years of employment - because sometimes 30 vacation days are not enough to explore the beauty of this world
  • PME Familienservice: A 24/7 support for a successful work & life in any life situation. Benefit from free support in areas like life coaching, child care and many other options
  • Mobility budget: Every month we contribute to your individual mobility usage with public transport or shared mobility offers within the app Moovster
  • Workation: Work from anywhere for up to 3 months per year - combining working at a nice place and spending your leisure time in the evening like vacation

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Show Production
description:
The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, audio technology, and product quality.

You have a strong engineering mindset, deep curiosity about how complex systems behave, and practical experience testing audio software in real-world environments. You are comfortable working close to the code, designing robust test automation, debugging across software and hardware boundaries, and helping teams build products that are reliable, observable, and easy to validate.

At HOLOPLOT, software is central to the design, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operation of sound systems.

Our show production team has been working on a wide range of audio applications/plugins for immersive audio content production that will work hand in hand with our sound system. Testing such applications and plugins requires more than checking whether features work. It requires an understanding of signal flow, timing, synchronization, real-time constraints, interoperability, and how audio systems fail in practice. It also requires creating representable mocks and setups that are effective, economical, and maintainable.


Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test in this team, you will partner closely with software engineers and product designers to define test strategies, build automation, and validate complex workflows across desktop applications, audio plugins, networked audio systems, and spatial audio features. You will develop automated, scalable test frameworks, explore test infrastructure, and increase confidence in release cycles.

You will work on both black-box and white-box testing approaches, depending on the problem: from backend-driven end-to-end tests to signal-analysis-based tests, UI validation, and system-level regression tests.

You will help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability, runtime, debuggability, and maintainability of the test suite.

You will create test tools that make it easier to automatically capture, analyze, compare, and validate audio behavior.

You will help teams move from manual validation toward reproducible, deterministic, and observable test workflows.


What you need to succeed in this role

Your skills and qualifications

  • A proven track record as a Software Development Engineer in Test, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on quality and automation.

  • Professional experience in the audio industry, preferably overlapping with the following fields: desktop audio applications, audio plugins, Audio-over-IP, spatial audio and immersive sound experience, embedded audio systems.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language such as Python.

  • Knowledge of C++ with a wish to learn more.

  • Experience designing and maintaining automated test frameworks, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and CI-based validation workflows.

  • A good understanding of digital audio fundamentals.

  • Experience testing desktop applications, in all major platforms.

  • Experience with audio plugin testing.

  • Good understanding of software architecture, testability, observability, and maintainable engineering practices.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain technical risks, test strategies, and failure modes clearly to developers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • An eye for detail, a tad of perfectionism, a can-do mentality, and the courage to take on new challenges

  • A mindset of curiosity and excellence

  • Positive vibes and desire to contribute to a productive and collegial working environment


Nice to haves

  • Experience with networked audio or real-time network protocols is highly valuable, especially AES67, Ravenna, Dante, RTP, PTP, multicast, or related technologies.

  • Experience with spatial audio technologies.

  • Experience testing multi-channel audio systems or large-scale professional audio installations.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

title: (Senior) Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
description:
paselo ist ein junges, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen für hochwertige Ergänzungsfuttermittel für Hunde. Unsere Mission: Die Gesundheit und Lebensfreude von Hunden nachhaltig zu fördern – mit natürlichen, laborgeprüften Produkten, die wissenschaftlich fundiert sind und von Tierhaltern geschätzt werden.

Um dieses Wachstum strukturiert voranzutreiben, suchen wir jemanden, der Creatives nicht verwaltet, sondern verantwortet.

Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer Anzeige, die hübsch ist, und einer, die kauft. Du weißt, warum Menschen klicken — und warum nicht. Du hast bewiesen, dass deine Arbeit Umsatz macht. Und du bist noch nicht fertig damit.

Worum es geht

Du bist der kreative Kopf hinter unseren Ads. Vom ersten Hook bis zur fertigen Performance-Analyse. Das ist keine reine Koordinationsrolle. Du denkst strategisch und setzt selbst um. Du baust Funnels, keine Einzeltexte.

Aufgaben

  • Funnel-Ownership statt Einzeltexte. Du denkst in Customer Journeys — von der ersten Impression bis zum Kauf. Landing Pages, Advertorials, Listicles, VSLs, Meta Ads, UGC-Scripte: Du weißt, was auf Meta, Google und Native funktioniert, und warum.
  • VSL- und Video-Konzepte. Du entwickelst Konzepte und schreibst Skripte für Meta und YouTube — Hook-getrieben und getestet, nicht geraten.
  • Briefings, die ohne dich funktionieren. Du schreibst Creative-Briefings, die Editoren und UGC-Creator eigenständig umsetzen. So klar, dass niemand nachfragen muss.
  • Performance lesen, Hypothesen ableiten. Du liest die Creative-Performance aus dem Ads Manager, ziehst Schlüsse und briefst die nächste Iteration. CVR, CAC, AOV und ROAS sind für dich kein Reporting, sondern Werkzeug.
  • Strukturiertes Testing. A/B-Tests sind keine Kür, sondern Grundhaltung. Du planst Creative-Rotationen und baust einen Testing-Prozess auf, der skaliert.
  • Zielgruppen-Instinkt. Du sprichst Menschen an, keine Personas — bei uns Hundehalter, für die der Hund Familie ist. Du triffst, was sie bewegt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung als Creative Stratgist im Performance Creative / Direct-Response, idealerweise im DTC-E-Commerce.
  • Nachweisbare Ergebnisse. Du nennst konkrete Zahlen. Kampagnen, die du verantwortet hast, Copy, die messbar konvertiert hat. Kein Portfolio ohne Proof.
  • Nachweisbare Ergebnisse mit Meta Video Ads (VSLs, UGC-Style, Hook-Testing).
  • Verkaufspsychologie im Blut. AIDA ist für dich ein Anfang, kein Ziel. Du kennst Hooks und Storytelling-Strukturen (PAS, DIC, Before/After) und weißt, was Scarcity, Urgency und Social Proof wirklich leisten — und wann man sie weglässt.
  • AI-Native Workflow. Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ein Profi. Zum Recherchieren, Ideenfinden, Varianten-Skalieren und um Konzepte schnell umzusetzen. Aber du weißt: Der Unterschied zwischen mittelmäßig und brillant hängt immer noch an dir.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch. Du schreibst Copy, die sich liest wie ein Brief an eine gute Bekannte — nicht wie ein Beipackzettel. Niveau, das verkauft, nicht Niveau, das beeindruckt.
  • Macher-Mentalität. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings. Du bringst Ideen, setzt sie um und misst das Ergebnis. Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt, was als Nächstes dran ist.

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung im FMCG E-Commerce (Skincare, Pet, Supplements, Heilpflege, ...)

Benefits

  • Leistungsgerechte Bezahlung. Wer abliefert, verdient überdurchschnittlich.
  • Echte Eigenverantwortung. Gesamtverantwortung für den Creative-Prozess. Deine Entscheidungen, deine Ergebnisse.
  • Direkter Zugang zum Founder. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Abstimmungs-Pingpong.
  • Kein 9-to-5. Du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeit selbst.
  • Kleines Team, flache Hierarchien. Du gestaltest mit, statt zu verwalten.
  • Regelmäßiger Austausch in unserem Büro in Münster.

title: Solution Architect (all genders)

Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you.

title: Postdoctoral Researcher in geospatial political data (SDC-32)
description:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on January 1, 2027 our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation, located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Postdoctoral Researcher in geospatial political data
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 100 %, initially limited to 4 years)
 

The department „Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. “Monitoring Electoral Democracy” (MEDem) is an emerging European Research Infrastructure Consortium (ERIC) that will enable more comprehensive and innovative comparative democracy research by linking data sources, encouraging standards, and developing tools for data collection and analysis (www.medem.eu). Our team Survey Data Augmentation hosts the MEDem Service Center Linkage.


Your tasks will be:

  • Developing linking tools for geo-coded data to advance democracy research
  • Coordinating with other MEDem Service Centers on dealing with geo-coded information
  • Contributing to the general conceptual, organizational, and technical development of MEDem
  • Collaborating within the team “Survey Data Augmentation”; includes regular presence at the office
  • Writing related grant proposals


Your profile:

title: Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC).


A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics-based modelling, hardware–software co-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements.

As part of our initiative towards fault-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations & Concepts team and are looking for a Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d) to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company.


Role Overview:

As Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d), you will help shaping eleQtron’s long-term roadmap towards logical quantum computing, driving research activities in quantum error correction and fault tolerance, contributing to key architectural decisions, coordinating cross-functional efforts across hardware, software, system architecture and applications, and playing a leading role in building and growing the company’s fault-tolerance capability.


Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and drive fault-tolerant quantum-computing strategies and logical architectures for trapped-ion MAGIC quantum processors.

  • Lead hardware-aware quantum error-correction studies and guide architectural decisions for future processor generations.

  • Coordinate realistic performance models connecting hardware characterization, circuit-level noise models, and logical performance metrics.

  • Work closely with System Architecture, System Operations, Software Engineering, and Quantum Applications teams to support the co-design of future fault-tolerant quantum computers.

  • Contribute to the development and mentoring of a growing fault-tolerance team while supporting eleQtron’s long-term technology roadmap.


Required Skills:

  • PhD in Physics, Quantum Information and Computation, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated scientific leadership and the ability to drive independent research activities.

  • Ability to work effectively across theory, hardware, software, and engineering disciplines.

  • Work in an international, agile and ambitious team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Join Autonomous Teaming Solutions and build next-generation autonomous robotic systems for demanding real-world environments. You will take end-to-end technical ownership and responsibility of a mission-critical robotics product where perception, system performance, and reliability directly impact operational success. 

As Principal Engineer, you carry overall technical responsibility. You have the final word on architecture, integration and deployment - and you carry the consequences when the system fails. No project manager above you. You decide, you deliver. You work directly with company leadership, not as a career step, but because you are the deepest technically. Your place is still in the team: building, not reporting.

  • You own a complex autonomous system end-to-end - from architecture to field deployment.
  • You build yourself solutions - every day, in the code, next to your team. With us, leading means going first.
  • You are the tiebreaker on technical decisions across all subsystems.
  • You cut whatever does not pay into the next milestone - before you optimize.
  • You test in the field, with measurable and clear pass/fail criteria.


Your profile

  • You are a builder. You have already put things into the world. Systems, products, projects with real users. Not just planned, not conceptualized: built.
  • You have built something of your own before: a company, a product, a project with no one standing behind you. You know what real responsibility feels like. 
  • Deep knowledge in real-time embedded systems, sensor fusion or perception. Proven by systems that run and make a difference. 
  • You have taken something from zero to running hard- and software solutions. Solely responsible, with numbers to show for it.
  • C++ and ROS2 under a latency budget is your terrain.
  • Your first reaction to a new requirement is to ask whether it can be dropped.
  • You have made engineers better by building next to them and coach them.
  • You build in your own time too, because you cannot do otherwise.


What else

  • Citizenship of a NATO member country or close ally.


Why us?

How we work

Clear ownership, everything else is bureaucracy. Every system has exactly one owner with the final word. No V-model, no phase gates, no sign-off meetings. Requirements get challenged, not worked through. Delete first, then simplify, then accelerate - in that order.

Our milestones are binary. Testing happens in the field, not in simulation.


What you get
  • Full technical authority over a system in active deployment.
  • Direct contact with the customer, no layers in between.
  • A team that owns the mission itself.
  • Munich, 5 days on-site. We build together.

No job for you if
  • You need three meetings before a decision gets made.
  • You want a title. What we hand out is the final word and full consequence.
  • A good design matters more to you than a running, functional system.

title: (Senior) Product Designer (f/m/d)
description:
Description

You will design the end-to-end product experience through which semiconductor engineers plan, set up, conduct, and evaluate experiments using our quantum sensing and metrology systems. This journey begins before a user opens the software: it includes experiment planning, sample preparation and mounting, instrument configuration, measurement, data analysis, and reporting.

While the majority of your work will focus on our software platform, you will design across the complete hardware-software workflow. You will consider how users move between physical equipment, samples, controls, system states, and digital interfaces - and identify opportunities to make the entire process more intuitive, reliable, and efficient.

Working closely with engineers, physicists, machine learning specialists, and customers, you will lead design challenges from discovery and workflow definition through validation and delivery. This is an opportunity to shape products at the intersection of scientific instrumentation, software, hardware, and user-centered design.


Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.


Why join us?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible!


What will you do

  • Own the end-to-end user experience across experiment planning, sample mounting, instrument setup, calibration, measurement, data analysis, and reporting. Develop a deep understanding of laboratory workflows, user goals, environmental constraints, dependencies, and potential sources of error.
  • Map complete user journeys across physical and digital touch points, identifying friction, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Design workflows and interfaces for our quantum sensing software platform, from early concepts through implementation-ready specifications.
  • Conduct contextual research, customer interviews, workflow observations, and usability testing with internal users and external customers. Prototype and evaluate software interactions and hardware-adjacent workflows, including instrument configuration, system feedback, and error recovery.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and clear interaction specifications in Figma. Design effective visualizations for measurement data, simulation results, system states, uncertainty, confidence indicators, and potential errors.
  • Collaborate with engineers, physicists, machine learning specialists, and product stakeholders to translate user needs and technical constraints into effective experiences. Facilitate design reviews, explain the evidence and trade-offs behind decisions, and work with engineering throughout implementation to ensure quality and consistency.
  • Develop and maintain a scalable design system across the software platform and connected instrument experiences. Contribute to product discovery, prioritization, and new product capabilities, while documenting research findings, user workflows, design decisions, and interaction patterns.
Senior candidates may also lead ambiguous cross-product initiatives, influence product strategy, mentor colleagues, and help establish design practices across the organization.


What is expected of you

  • Professional experience designing complex B2B, technical, scientific, industrial, or data-intensive products, supported by a strong portfolio covering research, workflow and interaction design, prototyping, validation, and collaboration with engineering teams.
  • The ability to understand and improve journeys spanning software, hardware, physical processes, and operational constraints, while simplifying complex systems without removing important functionality, context, or user control.
  • Strong interaction design, information architecture, and visual design skills, with experience conducting user research and usability testing and applying the findings to product decisions.
  • Confidence owning design work from discovery and problem definition through delivery, including identifying usability risks, sources of error, and opportunities to improve the reliability and efficiency of technical workflows.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills when working with highly technical stakeholders, combined with a user-centered, analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative approach.
  • A background in interaction design, product design, human-computer interaction, industrial design, computer science, or equivalent professional experience, together with the ability and willingness to work closely with a multidisciplinary team on-site in Munich.

Depending on your level of experience, different things matter:

  • At a mid-level, you're comfortable independently owning defined product areas and end-to-end workflows.

  • At a senior level, you're additionally able to lead ambiguous initiatives, influence product direction, align stakeholders across disciplines, and raise design quality across teams.


Nice to have:
  • Experience designing products that combine software, hardware, and physical interactions, particularly scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, engineering software, industrial systems, or other complex technical products.
  • Familiarity with laboratory workflows, sample handling, equipment configuration, experimental processes, service design, journey mapping, systems thinking, or human-factors design.
  • Experience with data visualization, analytics products, simulation software, or safety-critical, error-sensitive, and high-precision workflows.
  • Experience creating or maintaining design systems, familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design practices, or basic knowledge of Python, Qt, Git, or version-controlled workflows. Programming experience is not required for this role.


Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.
  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.
  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.
  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.
  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.
  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.
  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.
